HomeIframe.title: Google Solitaire
HomeIframe.description: Play Google Solitaire online in your browser. Enjoy the classic card game for free!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Google Solitaire is a single-player card game playable in your browser, based on the classic solitaire gameplay developed by Wes Cherry.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Build four foundation piles (hearts, diamonds, clubs, and spades) from A to K.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Move cards from the tableau to the foundation piles or between tableau columns.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Construct sequences in descending order with alternating colors (e.g., black queen on a red king).
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Suitable for different player preferences and skill levels, from beginners to experts in Google Solitaire.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy to operate with a clean and intuitive user interface in Google Solitaire.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: As a web-based game, you can access Google Solitaire on various devices and enjoy it anytime, anywhere.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Allows players to undo the previous step, making it easy to correct mistakes or explore different strategies in Google Solitaire.
